echoParts: There is no one who understands
verseText: As it is written: “There is no one righteous, not even one. There is no one who understands, no one who seeks God.”
meaning: It is written in many places in the Bible that no one is truly righteous. Nobody is perfect. Nobody always does what God says is right. That's why we need Jesus to save us.
